Roasted Garlic Spread
By: Barbara Pendleton
Published: Thursday, April 25, 2013 - 12:52pm

Ingredients




Garlic Bunch
Olive Oil
Parmesan Cheese (grated for smooth texture or shredded for chunky texture)

Preparation

1 Cut top off Garlic Bunch 2 Coat with Olive Oil 3 Roast garlic on 350° for 45 minutes 4 Cover bottom of small bowl with olive oil 5 Squeeze garlic out of skin into bowl 6 Add Cheese 7 Press garlic with fork and combine all ingredients 8 Add cheese and/or oil to form a spread consistency

About

Butter, Oil, Forget about it!  Make a Garlic Spread for your bread!
